The Foundation record is the identity-exact label but carries no energy, total fat, carbohydrate, or sodium rows, so it is preserved in the adjudication audit trail as a rejected-for-base candidate and is not merged into this profile. The mayonnaise-type dressing record 171403 is a different product and was not used.

entries.description: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D

The nonfat-solids and protein-fortified records are rejected.
